description: Header file defining the HpackStringDecoder class for decoding HPACK-encoded strings in HTTP/2 headers, including methods for starting and resuming decoding, handling Huffman encoding, and managing decoder state.

classes.name: HpackStringDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding strings encoded with HPACK in HTTP/2 headers, managing decoding state, Huffman encoding, and providing start/resume decoding methods.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding an HPACK string from the buffer, handling short strings and delegating to Resume for longer or partial strings.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Continues decoding based on current state, handling length decoding and string data extraction.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state for debugging.

methods.name: StartDecodingLength
methods.description: Decodes the length of the string, handling partial data across buffers.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingLength
methods.description: Resumes decoding the length if it was split across buffers.

methods.name: OnStringStart
methods.description: Callback to notify listener of the start of a string, including Huffman encoding and length.

methods.name: DecodeString
methods.description: Decodes and passes string data to the listener, signaling end when complete.
